groups.canonical_name: Right to repair data security exposure
groups.definition: Right to repair laws could require third-party access to vehicle data and systems, creating security vulnerabilities.
Expanding global data privacy and AI rules such as GDPR and CCPA impose rising compliance costs and penalty exposure.

groups.canonical_name: Emissions and fuel economy regulation compliance
groups.definition: Stricter or violated fuel economy and emissions rules can raise costs, limit profitable vehicle sales, and trigger penalties, credit purchases or recalls.
Environmental rules may require abatement equipment, elimination of materials or processes, or emissions fees, raising manufacturing costs.
A broad range of international, national and local laws imposes compliance costs and enforcement actions or fines from government inquiries.
